Maya K: Heads-up — preflight for release train 26. New quiet-window guidance rolled into Release Ops; please read bottom. :loud_sound:
Oliver: TL;DR?
Maya K: Two things: (1) international cutover windows now require a 4h quiet window for infra-facing changes, (2) hold on rc3 promotes pending canary validation in ap-southeast1 due to tail latency.
Release Bot: canary-monitor: ap-southeast1 p95 spike 380ms between 03:12-03:28 UTC; error-rate +2.1%
Jamie (SRE): Rolled canary back to v26-rc2 at 03:30 as a precaution. Observed KV miss-rate jump that lines up with a compaction job on the storage tier.
Tess: I'll coordinate with Data Infra to shift compaction off canary hosts. Opening incident channel if we don't see stabilization in 45m.
Charlie: Does this block the staging promotes scheduled at 04:15? Need explicit decision to pause.
Maya K: Promotes paused. Mandatory 2h canary extension; reassess at 05:00 UTC. No org-wide freeze, but train 26 is quiet until we clear.
Oliver: If we need a rollback command on short notice?
Maya K: rollback cmd: releasectl rollback --env=canary --to=v26-rc1 --reason="ap-southeast1 p95 regression"
Jamie (SRE): Metrics @03:45 UTC: p95 ~210ms, error-rate 0.9%. KV miss-rate trending down after pausing compaction on affected nodes.
Tess: Monitoring cadence set to 15m; will post updates at 04:00 and 04:30. If p95 > 300ms for a consecutive 10m window, I'll escalate and spin up incident/major.
Maya K: Action items: Tess watch canary, Jamie coordinate compaction mitigation and confirm throughput parity, Charlie freeze non-critical promotes and notify QA, Oliver gather model infra logs for correlation. Reconvene at 05:00 or on escalation. Thanks all.
